---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an API, workflow or documentation improvement
---

## Use case

What are you trying to build, and what is difficult with the current API?

## Proposed behavior

Show a small example of the desired behavior or API. Note whether it changes
validation, normalization, abstention, wire compatibility, features or the MSRV.

## Alternatives and scope

What existing APIs or application-level solutions have you considered? Explain
why the proposed change belongs in this library. Use synthetic examples; do not
include credentials or private input data.
